name: inline-context-styled
description: The same question as `inline-context`, asked of a theme that names ONE axis of the codespan's font style. `to_styles` turns `bold` into a one-element set and `update_fragment` merges it, so the renderer forces the weight everywhere and still takes the slant from the markup — while the `:monospaced` column branch, which reads only the codespan's family, size and colour, takes neither. The theme also gives the codespan a chip, so the raster says which constructs the renderer paints one behind.
